title: netGuaranteed > 0 is a false green: it does not imply withdraw is executable, on either strategy, for three independent reasons
description: previewExitFor reports a positive, apparently-healthy floor in states where withdraw() is guaranteed to revert. Three independent mechanisms produce this, each needing a different code change: (a) AMM price blindness on the market strategy — IAMMAdapter has exactly one member, a non-view swap, CurveAMMAdapter exposes no quote, and _exitFloor is provably invariant to AMM price while _disposeShares passes that same number as minOut at :246; (b) vault redemption throttle on the direct strategy — zero occurrences of maxRedeem/maxWithdraw anywhere in first-party src/, and _disposeShares calls vault.redeem unconditionally; (c) finite AMM depth on the market strategy — the depth-blind floor breaches minOut at an unmoved mid-price for a large request.
impact: The entire withdraw / withdrawAsOwner / totalWithdrawal path of the market strategy is bricked for EVERY client while the condition holds (_disposeShares is the single shared exit hook), while the new preview reports green. INV-3 is the dominant failure mode on both strategies (v3_nonZeroQuoteRevert 127 direct / 90 market). Held at Low, not Medium on the availability limb, on measured grounds: (a) and (c) are a minOut slippage guard doing its job (fail-loud is correct behaviour), transient and self-clearing, with an owner lever; and (b)'s throttle was MEASURED not to bind on the deployed Autopools.
attackPath: An integrator STATICCALLs previewExitFor and receives netGuaranteed >= netWanted.
In the same block, one of (a)/(b)/(c) holds: the AMM bids below the NAV-anchored minOut, or the Autopool's maxRedeem is below the shares needed, or the request exceeds AMM depth.
withdraw() reverts. The pre-flight signal the story added was green in exactly the state where the call is guaranteed to fail.
Before cdd0743 there was no pre-flight signal at all and a consumer had to try-and-revert; now there is one, documented with the word 'guarantees', and it is wrong.
recommendation: Each instance needs its own change and a fix landing only one is an INCOMPLETE FIX, not a fix. (a)+(c): add a size-aware quote member to IAMMAdapter (wrap ICurveRouterNG.get_dy(amountIn), not a mid-price) and return netGuaranteed = 0 when the live route cannot clear minOut. (b): consult maxRedeem/maxWithdraw in both the preview and _disposeShares.
